source.title: The Blood of the Lightbringer
source.description: Your hand trembles slightly as you hold the small vial of blood. Aside from the inscription on the label, you can feel a warmth and energy radiating from the sample. Could this truly be the blood of the legendary hero, Uther the Lightbringer? You should find someone who can verify the authenticity of this sample.
source.objective:
Find someone who can tell you more about the Blood of the Lightbringer.

(Please note that you need to have previously completed the quest "Plaguelands Rendezvous" to be able to hand in this quest)
source.completion:
Wait, what is that you have there?

<High Priest Thel'danis' eyes go wide as he examines the reliquary>

Surely this cannot be. How would the black dragons obtain a sample of Lord Uther's blood?

If this is genuine, this would become a relic of profound importance. Let us speak further on this.
